presentation.summary: Keeps Silo's movie and series posters and collections matching Plex, including Kometa's overlays.
presentation.description_markdown: Mirrors movie and series posters and Plex collections from Plex into Silo. Works great with Kometa: by default it copies the posters Kometa has overlaid, and Kometa's run_end webhook starts a sync after every Kometa run. Season and episode artwork is never touched.
presentation.setup_markdown:
1. Create an admin API key in Silo and paste it into the settings.
2. Enter your Plex URL and token, and set a webhook secret.
3. Open the plugin's status page to choose libraries.
4. With Kometa, copy the webhook URL from the status page into Kometa's `webhooks: run_end:` setting. Without Kometa, turn off "Only posters Kometa has overlaid" and give the Plex Artwork Sync task a schedule.

capabilities.description: Syncs movie/series posters and collections from Plex into Silo. Kometa's run_end webhook can trigger it; you can also run it here or give it a schedule.
Receives Kometa's run_end webhook, serves the status page, and hands posters to Silo during a sync.

fields.label: Plex URL
fields.description: Address Silo can reach Plex at, e.g. http://plex:32400

fields.label: Plex token
fields.description: Required. After saving, Silo shows this field empty; leave it empty to keep the saved token.

fields.label: Silo admin API key
fields.description: Required. An unscoped admin API key (starts with sa_), used to apply posters and manage collections. After saving, Silo shows this field empty; leave it empty to keep the saved key.

fields.label: Silo internal URL (optional)
fields.description: Only needed if auto-detection fails. Silo's own API address as Silo sees it, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8080

fields.label: Webhook secret
fields.description: Required. Any long random string. Kometa (or anything else calling the webhook) sends it as ?secret= on the webhook URL. After saving, Silo shows this field empty; leave it empty to keep the saved secret.

fields.label: Delay after the webhook (minutes)
fields.description: Wait this long after Kometa's run_end webhook before syncing. Doesn't affect scheduled or manual runs.

fields.label: Only posters Kometa has overlaid
fields.description: When on, only items carrying Kometa's "Overlay" label in Plex are synced. Turn off to sync every movie and series poster in the selected libraries.

fields.label: Delete Silo collections removed from Plex
fields.description: Only collections this plugin created are ever deleted.

fields.label: Dry run
fields.description: Log what would change without writing anything to Silo.
